data.user_prompt: how to monitor company insolvency notices in Australia

sections.text: I'll search for information on how to monitor company insolvency notices in Australia.

Here are the main ways to monitor company insolvency notices in Australia:

## Official ASIC Source

All notices relating to the appointment of an external administrator (Liquidator, Administrator, Receiver/Receiver and Manager) to a company are published on the Insolvency Notices Website maintained by ASIC at www.insolvencynotices.asic.gov.au

sections.text: You can search the website by company name or ACN to check if a company has gone into liquidation, and you do not need to be registered or pay a fee to search
